description: This Java class 'SurveyMapper' provides static utility methods for converting between domain model objects (e.g., Survey, Question, Response, Component) and their Data Transfer Object counterparts (e.g., SurveyData, QuestionData, ResponseData, ComponentData). It handles mapping of nested collections and maintains consistent linkage between objects. The class facilitates serialization/deserialization of survey structures within the project.

classes.name: SurveyMapper
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for mapping between domain Survey/Question/Response/Component objects and their corresponding Data Transfer Objects. Handles nested collection conversions and maintains object relationships.

methods.name: map(final Survey survey)
methods.description: Converts a Survey domain object into a SurveyData DTO, including nested components and questions.

methods.name: map(final SurveyData surveyData, Survey survey)
methods.description: Updates an existing Survey object with data from a SurveyData DTO.

methods.name: mapComponents(final List<Component> components)
methods.description: Maps a list of Component objects to a list of ComponentData DTOs.

methods.name: mapComponentDatas(final List<ComponentData> componentDatas, final Survey survey)
methods.description: Creates Component objects from a list of ComponentData DTOs and associates them with a Survey.

methods.name: mapQuestions(final List<Question> questions)
methods.description: Maps a list of Question objects to a list of QuestionData DTOs, including responses.

methods.name: mapQuestionDatas(final List<QuestionData> questionDatas, final Survey survey)
methods.description: Creates Question objects from a list of QuestionData DTOs and associates them with a Survey.

methods.name: mapResponses(final List<Response> responses)
methods.description: Maps a list of Response objects to a list of ResponseData DTOs.

methods.name: mapResponseDatas(final List<ResponseData> responseDatas, final Question question)
methods.description: Creates Response objects from a list of ResponseData DTOs and associates them with a Question.
